[Arboreal Boots](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3056)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 285

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These soft leather boots are embossed with simple woodland scenes. The boots grant a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics and allow you to ignore difficult terrain from plants and fungi.

The boots grant a +2 bonus. You also gain a 10-foot climb Speed while climbing plants or fungi and don't need to use your hands to Climb them.
